summary.headline: Astrological Topics 60–76
summary.text: Astrological chapter list, items 60–76, covering Masalla’s and Ptolemy’s radiations, Euclid’s figures, rumor, aphetai, malefics, Mercury and Mars, birth hours, Ophiuchus, dodekatemoria, comets, Jupiter, the Jupiter–Saturn conjunction, full-moon aphetai, adversaries, warfare, and palace-held mathematical books. Authorities named include Apomasar, Aposait, Sadan, Euclid, Ptolemy, and Stephanos, with references to an appendix and the Florentine catalogue.
